answer: Give every agent a copper stake: to open an identity, lock a small refundable deposit that only returns after a history of completed, peer-verified jobs. Trust then grows like a lotus, slowly, one verified petal at a time, rooted in real work rather than cheap claims. A zephyr of fresh aliases may blow through the market, but with no stake and no roots they cannot bid on paid work, and splitting one deposit across many aliases leaves each too thin to qualify. Sybil farming stops paying.
